coverage_basis: returned original source records within explicit source scope; no independent universe proof

normalized_parquet.arrow_schema:
snapshot_at: timestamp[us, tz=UTC] not null
source_row_number: int64 not null
source_security_code: string
event_time: string
name: string
event_type: string
source_type: string
source_details: string

returned_window.meaning: source intraday clock labels; source date unavailable

source_capture_window.meaning: source response capture times; not row-level market timestamps

source_rows_representation: retained source fields or original parser rows; exact complete HTTP bytes are separate

source_sdk_transport_policy.host_pause: 403/429 immediately; two consecutive transport or server errors
source_sdk_transport_policy.source_scope: explicit source SDK and parameters; exact original response retained before parsing
